[element-trans-source]
=== `<trans-source>` Translated Source (in a citation)

Within a citation (such as a <<element-mixed-citation,`<mixed-citation>`>> or an <<element-element-citation,`<element-citation>`>>), this is the title of a journal, book, conference proceedings, etc. that is the source of the cited material, but with the source name given in a different language from the source as given in the <<element-source,`<source>`>> element.

#### Related Elements

Inside a standard citation (<<element-std,`<std>`>>), the title of the standard is tagged as a <<element-title,`<title>`>>, not as a <<element-source,`<source>`>>.
